claims: The Gospels document that God raised Jesus from the dead on the third day following his crucifixion.
The resurrection of Jesus is celebrated on Easter.
Women followers, including Mary Magdalene, found the tomb empty on Sunday morning.
The stone was rolled away from the tomb.
All four Gospels (Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John) detail the resurrection.
The four Gospels note appearances of the risen Jesus to his disciples and others.
The accounts emphasize a bodily resurrection, not just a spiritual one.
The Apostle Paul stated that if Christ was not raised, Christian faith is futile.
Jesus first appeared to Mary Magdalene outside the tomb.
Jesus appeared to two disciples walking to Emmaus.
Jesus opened the Scriptures to the two disciples on the road to Emmaus.
Jesus invited Thomas to touch his wounds to prove his physical resurrection.
The risen Christ commanded his disciples to preach the gospel to all nations.
